department: Department of Computer Science and Technology

deadline.value: Funding deadline December 8, 2026 (apply by this date to enter the University funding competition); the final application deadline is later, but too late for most funding.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 107 overall with at least 25 in each section; this course sets its own English level.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL Internet Score Element Score Listening 25 Writing 25 Reading 25 Speaking 25 Total 107

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall (Listening 7.0, Writing 7.0, Reading 7.0, Speaking 7.0).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (Academic) Element Score Listening 7.0 Writing 7.0 Reading 7.0 Speaking 7.0 Total 7.5

supervisor.value: Must discuss the research with a potential supervisor and have the proposed supervisor's permission to apply.
supervisor.quote: Please indicate that you have the permission of the proposed supervisor to submit an application for admission.

funding.value: EPSRC and Premium Scholarship funding require applying by the December deadline; awards are limited.
funding.quote: Applicants seeking funding from either the EPSRC DTP or Premium Scholarship fund must have submitted their applications by the December deadline.

entry_route.value: First-class honours or equivalent is required; a master's-level degree is highly desirable.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have a first-class honours degree or equivalent.

notes: Higher English level than most courses (IELTS 7.5, TOEFL 107).
